purpose: Teach: ダブル/ショット/直感/展覧/演じる/細い/逃げる/助ける

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、テニス部で、本気で、絶対、ダブル、絶対、ス、絶対、お前、絶対、得意だよね
lines.en: Riku, you're seriously incredible at doubles tennis, aren't you?
lines.style: Warm admiration with a teasing lilt. Direct eye contact, slight smile. Not overstated — the compliment lands because she means it. Light, genuine.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。試合の、本気で、絶対、ショット、絶対、決めたぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. I nailed the shot when it mattered, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet confidence, no boasting. Says it simply and moves on. The kind of guy who knows what he did without needing to advertise it. Slight softness when he says her name.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前の、本気で、絶対、直感、絶対、いつも、絶対、当たるよね、リク、本気for
lines.en: Your instincts are always right on, aren't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, a little vulnerable. She's noticing something about him — maybe testing his reaction. Slight pause before 'always.' Genuine curiosity underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前と、本気で、絶対、美術館の、絶対、展覧、絶対、会、絶対、行きたいぜ、桜
lines.en: I want to go to that museum exhibition with you, Sakura.
lines.style: Sudden, sincere. The words come out before he's fully planned them. Slight breathiness, like he's decided something and committed to it. Looking at her, not away.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 文化祭の、本気で、絶対、劇、絶対、お前、絶対、主役、絶対、演じる、絶対、んだよね、リク
lines.en: So you're playing the lead in the cultural festival play, huh?
lines.style: Curious and impressed, but holding it lightly. Not big praise — observing something she's doing. Genuine interest in how she landed there. Slight questioning lift at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、最近、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、細い、絶対、ぜ、桜
lines.en: You've looked a little thin lately, you know?
lines.style: Gentle concern, not accusatory. He's noticed because he pays attention. Says it quietly, like he's checking in rather than criticizing. Soft edge on the delivery — he cares.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 試験から、本気で、絶対、逃げる、絶対、わけにいかないよね、リク
lines.en: You can't exactly run from exams, can you?
lines.style: Practical, a little sympathetic. She's resigned to something. Not lecturing — understanding her frustration while pointing at the reality. Slight weariness in the pacing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、困った時、絶対、絶対、助ける、絶対、ぜ、桜
lines.en: When you're in trouble, I'm going to be there for you, Sakura.
lines.style: Absolute conviction. Slow, steady delivery. He's not offering help — he's making a promise. No hesitation. The kind of thing he means for years to come. Direct and unflinching.
